Overview.Name: Thakkelapalli Swapna
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry (no cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli) + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd + paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & carrot or beans curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry & buttermilk

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid cabbage, cauliflower and broccoli completely.
Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice to control portions.
For cravings, eat your regular meal first and wait 10 minutes before taking anything extra.
Avoid fried foods and outside snacks as much as possible.
Consistency in meals will help improve thyroid health and overall energy.
